title: With -flambda2-expert-cmm-safe-subst, a read is still moved past a call when a branch follows the call
summary: `-flambda2-expert-cmm-safe-subst` keeps a delayed read before a later call, but not when a test, a join, an exception handler or a loop stands between the call and the use. Here the read of a string lent by `Bytes.unsafe_to_string` is done after a call that writes the bytes.
cause: `middle_end/flambda2/to_cmm/to_cmm_env.ml`, `flush_delayed_lets` in mode `Branching_point`: the call is emitted, the pure read is kept, and the validity stages are rebuilt from the bindings kept, so the record that a call came after the read is lost.

fix.text: Keeps that record when the stages are rebuilt. Builds; with it `test.ml` prints the expected result; testsuite unchanged.

reference: related: issue #4803 (a call moved after a load; not the same)
